**BGCache 0.9.0 beta 5.** Live playback for heavy Maya shots, while you keep animating. Maya 2024 or later.

### New
- **More footage formats in continuity (Full edition):** movies in anything ffmpeg plays (AVI, MKV, MXF, WebM, MPEG, WMV... as well as MOV and MP4), and image sequences in EXR, DPX, TGA, BMP and more as well as JPEG, PNG and TIFF. EXR and DPX frames are read through ffmpeg, with the usual sRGB look for EXR.

Everything from [0.9.0 beta 4](https://github.com/Marek-672/Maya-Tools/releases/tag/bgcache-v0.9.0b4) is in here too: the Full edition with **Set up continuity**, focus range playback, and **Help > Report a problem > Send**.

### Download
**Which one?** Simple if you just want your own shot playing in real time with drawing. Full adds continuity: the shots around yours playing with it. Full does everything Simple does, and continuity stays off until you set it up, so if you're unsure, take Full. **Help > About** in the player says which one you have.

Click a file to download it (they're also under **Assets** at the bottom of this page).

| Your system | Simple (cache, player, drawing) | Full (+ continuity) |
|---|---|---|
| Windows | [bgcache-0.9.0b5-windows-simple.zip](https://github.com/Marek-672/Maya-Tools/releases/download/bgcache-v0.9.0b5/bgcache-0.9.0b5-windows-simple.zip) | [bgcache-0.9.0b5-windows-full.zip](https://github.com/Marek-672/Maya-Tools/releases/download/bgcache-v0.9.0b5/bgcache-0.9.0b5-windows-full.zip) |
| macOS (Apple Silicon; the least tested so far) | [bgcache-0.9.0b5-macos-simple.zip](https://github.com/Marek-672/Maya-Tools/releases/download/bgcache-v0.9.0b5/bgcache-0.9.0b5-macos-simple.zip) | [bgcache-0.9.0b5-macos-full.zip](https://github.com/Marek-672/Maya-Tools/releases/download/bgcache-v0.9.0b5/bgcache-0.9.0b5-macos-full.zip) |
| Linux | [bgcache-0.9.0b5-linux-simple.zip](https://github.com/Marek-672/Maya-Tools/releases/download/bgcache-v0.9.0b5/bgcache-0.9.0b5-linux-simple.zip) | [bgcache-0.9.0b5-linux-full.zip](https://github.com/Marek-672/Maya-Tools/releases/download/bgcache-v0.9.0b5/bgcache-0.9.0b5-linux-full.zip) |

### Install or update
- **Already have BGCache:** in the player, **Help > Check for updates** offers the newest of your edition. To move from Simple to Full, drag in the Full zip's installer.
- **New:** unzip the file for your system, drag `install_bgcache.py` into a Maya viewport and choose **Install**, then click the **bgcache** shelf button.

Full list of changes: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/Marek-672/Maya-Tools/blob/main/bgcache/CHANGELOG.md). User guide: [bgcache/README.md](https://github.com/Marek-672/Maya-Tools/blob/main/bgcache/bgcache/README.md).

**Beta:** problems to **Help > Report a problem > Send**, or [Issues](https://github.com/Marek-672/Maya-Tools/issues/new/choose). If BGCache saves you time, you can say thanks at [ko-fi.com/marekkochout](https://ko-fi.com/marekkochout).
